negative_findings.description: Poštna banka Slovenije (PBS), named in the coverage cell, is no longer an independent contracting entity. Nova KBM became sole owner in March 2016 and the legal merger completed 1 September 2016; Nova KBM itself has since been absorbed into OTP banka. No current PBS-branded procurement channel was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for PBS procurement returned only merger/announcement pages on otpbanka.si and bank-profile directories, no tender channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell should re-point PBS coverage to (a) Pošta Slovenije for post-office payment/cash services and (b) OTP banka as a private-sector actor outside this A2 public-procurement cell — otherwise the collector chases a dead buyer.

negative_findings.description: Banka Slovenije's dedicated javna naročila landing page could not be located. A guessed path (https://www.bsi.si/o-nas/javna-narocila) returned HTTP 404, while search indexing shows a live '/JAVNA NAROČILA/<Month Year>/' document folder on bsi.si containing razpisna dokumentacija PDFs.
negative_findings.result_summary: 404 on guessed path; strong indirect evidence the section exists under a different URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis, not a verdict — the central bank is a high-value payments buyer and its tender documents appear to be self-hosted. A verification pass must resolve the correct path via the bsi.si content index before concluding anything.

negative_findings.description: ZZZS's own corporate javna naročila section was not located: https://www.zzzs.si/javna-narocila/ returned HTTP 404 and search results surfaced only the provider-facing razpisi on partner.zzzs.si.
negative_findings.result_summary: 404 on guessed corporate path; provider-portal razpisi confirmed instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: General IT / payment-collection / card-issuance procurements by ZZZS may be published somewhere other than the health-service razpisi pages; missing that section would leave a blind spot at Slovenia's single largest health payer.

negative_findings.description: SDH's published 'javni razpisi' are overwhelmingly governance/HR calls (management board, supervisor accreditation) and asset/claim sale calls, not IT or payments procurement.

negative_findings.result_summary: Zero live payment-specific tender documents retrieved in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that free-text web search is a poor discovery channel for these tenders: collection must go through naročnik+CPV-filtered queries on enarocanje.si / e-JN / TED rather than search engines.

coverage_gaps.description: Exact procurement URLs for Banka Slovenije and for ZZZS's corporate (non-provider) section remain unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a sitemap/site-index pass over bsi.si (https://www.bsi.si/sl/kazalo-vsebine) and zzzs.si, plus a site: query pass, to resolve both paths before the verification stage.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV-code-driven query set was built this run; without it, payment/ATM/card/IT procurement cannot be separated from the very large volume of unrelated tenders these buyers issue (medical devices, mail transport, real estate).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a CPV filter list (66xxxxxx financial and insurance services, 48xxxxxx software packages, 72xxxxxx IT services, 30123xxx self-service/ATM-class machines, 79940000 collection-agency services) and a Slovenian keyword set, and apply both on enarocanje.si, e-JN and TED.

coverage_gaps.description: Naročnik filtering fails silently unless exact registered legal names and aliases are known (SID banka d.d.; Kapitalska družba d.d.; Zavod za zdravstveno zavarovanje Slovenije; Zavod za pokojninsko in invalidsko zavarovanje Slovenije; Pošta Slovenije d.o.o.; Banka Slovenije; Ministrstvo za finance — Finančna uprava RS; Slovenski državni holding d.d.).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a canonical alias table from AJPES / e-Uprava and store it as collector configuration, including English names for TED matching.

coverage_gaps.description: Naročila male vrednosti and non-binding 'javni pozivi za zbiranje informativnih ponudb' (notably at Pošta Slovenije and ZPIZ) sit below national-portal visibility or outside it entirely, yet they are the earliest demand signals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl buyer-own procurement pages directly at weekly cadence rather than relying on the national portal alone.

coverage_gaps.description: Award notices (obvestilo o oddaji naročila) and realised spend (ERAR/OPSI) were identified as sources but no join key between them was established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design a reconciliation key (buyer id + supplier tax number + year) so award notices and ERAR flows can be joined, given ERAR's documented value gaps.

coverage_gaps.description: Both primary portals (enarocanje.si SPA with a hash-fragment router, ejn.gov.si JSF/XHTML with viewstate) resist naive HTTP scraping, and no robots.txt / ToS review was performed this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Prototype a session-aware or headless-browser collector against both, and review robots.txt plus the published Splošni pogoji uporabe portala javnih naročil before automating.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian coverage was strong; English coverage is structurally thin because Slovenian notices are published in Slovenian only, with English available mainly as TED summaries of above-threshold notices.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Accept sl as the primary collection language and use TED EN only as a cross-check and for above-threshold buys; do not expect English-language discovery to find sub-threshold tenders.

brief: Slovenia's state-linked financial buyers publish procurement in a strongly centralised way: SID banka and Kapitalska družba explicitly state that all javna naročila go to the Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si / Uradni list RS) with e-JN as the submission layer, so their own sites are pointers rather than primary sources. Genuine own-site value concentrates in ZPIZ (live aktualna javna naročila plus archive and small-value procurements), Pošta Slovenije (a ZJN-3 sectoral entity that also runs non-binding informative-offer calls — the earliest demand signal in this cell), ZZZS's provider portal (partner.zzzs.si, on a roughly three-year supplier re-tender cycle), and Banka Slovenije, which appears to self-host razpisna dokumentacija under a /JAVNA NAROČILA/ folder whose landing page I could not resolve. Two cell members need re-framing: Poštna banka Slovenije no longer exists as a buyer (merged into Nova KBM in 2016, now OTP banka) and FURS procures as a unit of the Ministry of Finance rather than in its own name. Realised-spend visibility is available through ERAR and its OPSI open-data mirror, but ERAR has documented under-reporting on ZZZS-linked flows and must be reconciled against award notices.
